items.title: Art Farmer — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Me and Hank Mobley was in the group. We played around quite a bit.

ctx.x: That would’ve been after ’53. Do you remember the year that you played with Prez?…

Yeah, it must have been around ’55, somewhere around then. Then, I started getting gigs with Horace Silver. Horace had been with Art Blakey and the Jazz Messengers, which was a co-op group supposedly, with Hank Mobley and Kenny Durham. The bass player…
